title: Detailed lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M42 10 Q50 2 58 10" fill="none" stroke="#C0C0C0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 10 L40 14" stroke="#C0C0C0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 10 L60 14" stroke="#C0C0C0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Top cap -->
  <rect x="36" y="14" width="28" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="36" y="14" width="28" height="3" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Top rim -->
  <rect x="32" y="20" width="36" height="5" rx="1" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <rect x="32" y="20" width="36" height="2" rx="1" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <!-- Main glass body -->
  <rect x="34" y="25" width="32" height="40" rx="3" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Glass inner glow -->
  <rect x="36" y="27" width="28" height="36" rx="2" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <!-- Vertical frame bars -->
  <rect x="44" y="25" width="2" height="40" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <rect x="54" y="25" width="2" height="40" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <!-- Horizontal frame bar middle -->
  <rect x="34" y="42" width="32" height="2" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <!-- Flame -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="4" ry="7" fill="#FFA500"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="2.5" ry="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#FFF8DC"/>
  <!-- Flame wick -->
  <rect x="49" y="50" width="2" height="4" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- Bottom rim -->
  <rect x="32" y="65" width="36" height="5" rx="1" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <rect x="32" y="68" width="36" height="2" rx="1" fill="#D4A017"/>
  <!-- Bottom cap -->
  <rect x="36" y="70" width="28" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="36" y="73" width="28" height="3" rx="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- Bottom knob -->
  <rect x="46" y="76" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#C0C0C0"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x="38" y="79" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#A0A0A0"/>
  <rect x="57" y="79" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#A0A0A0"/>
  <!-- Decorative diamonds on frame top -->
  <polygon points="50,15 52,17 50,19 48,17" fill="#FF4444"/>
  <!-- Decorative diamonds on frame bottom -->
  <polygon points="50,71 52,73 50,75 48,73" fill="#FF4444"/>
  <!-- Side decorative swirls -->
  <path d="M36 32 Q38 30 36 28" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M64 32 Q62 30 64 28" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M36 56 Q38 58 36 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M64 56 Q62 58 64 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Small sparkles around flame -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="1" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="1" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="1" fill="#FFE44D"/>
</svg>
